---
title: "05 — M2: compute cost and carbon footprint"
author: "Adrien Taudière"
---

Accuracy versus compute cost of each assignment target. `benchmark_costs`
comes from the per-target {autometric} logs written inside the crew workers
(`R/autometric_helpers.R`, ROADMAP S1.1): wall time, peak resident memory and
mean CPU of the newest run of each target. M2.2 converts wall time to CO₂eq
with `greenAlgoR`.

The costs read here come from the current assignment stores, but every
cost measured before the final run of OD 31 (one computation at a time, fixed
threads, the desktop closed) is **provisional**: treat these figures as
placeholders, not as a recommendation (ROADMAP M2.4).

Every section has one tab per mock and ITSx region (`analysis_views()` in
`00_setup.R`), on the ASVs: Pauvert ITS1, then Tedersoo ITS1, ITS2 and full.
Each view reads the costs of its own dataset's assignment store
(`costs_for()`); the figures are saved once per view, suffixed with it.

```{r setup}
here::i_am("analysis/05_m2_costs.qmd")  # _quarto.yml would otherwise make here() root = analysis/
source(here::here("analysis/00_setup.R"))
res_all <- cache_read("res_comp_tax")
views <- analysis_views(res_all)

# Default-setting F1 of one view, at every rank.
f1_all_ranks <- function(res) {
  res |>
    filter(metrics == "F1_score") |>
    filter_default_settings() |>
    mutate(tax_level = factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order))
}
```

## Summary

```{r summary-data}
#| include: false
# Computed from the same views and filters as the tabs below: Genus F1 of the
# default columns joined to the wall time of the computation behind each.
s05_rows <- view_rows(res_all, views) |>
  filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == "Genus") |>
  filter_default_settings()
s05 <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(views)), function(i) {
  rows <- filter(s05_rows, view_id == views$id[i])
  rows |>
    left_join(
      costs_for(views$dataset[i], rows) |> select(phase, wall_time_s),
      by = c("method_db" = "phase")
    )
}) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  filter(!is.na(wall_time_s))
s05_by_algo <- s05 |>
  group_by(view, algo) |>
  summarise(minutes = mean(wall_time_s) / 60, f1 = mean(values), .groups = "drop")
s05_fast <- best_of(s05_by_algo, "algo", value = "minutes", best = min)
s05_slow <- best_of(s05_by_algo, "algo", value = "minutes")
s05_best <- best_of(s05_by_algo, "algo", value = "f1")
s05_ratio <- s05_slow$minutes / s05_fast$minutes
```

**Provisional costs** (OD 31): measured on this workstation during the
benchmark runs, not in the final one-computation-at-a-time run. Read the
orders of magnitude, not a recommendation. ASVs, default settings, wall time
of one computation (one method × one database) averaged over the nine
databases.

- **Fastest**: `r best_phrase(mutate(s05_fast, value = -minutes), "algo", show_value = FALSE)`
  — `r fmt_range(s05_fast$minutes, 1)` min per computation.
- **Slowest**: `r best_phrase(mutate(s05_slow, value = minutes), "algo", show_value = FALSE)`
  — `r fmt_range(s05_slow$minutes, 1)` min, `r fmt_range(s05_ratio, 0)` times
  the fastest.
- **Most accurate at Genus**: `r best_phrase(mutate(s05_best, value = f1), "algo")`,
  at `r fmt_range(s05_best$minutes, 1)` min per computation.

```{r summary-fig}
#| echo: false
fig_summary_05_f1_vs_time <- s05 |>
  ggplot(aes(x = wall_time_s / 60, y = values, colour = algo)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~view, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Wall time of the computation (min, log scale)",
    y = "Genus F1", colour = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
print(fig_summary_05_f1_vs_time)
save_fig(fig_summary_05_f1_vs_time, "fig_summary_05_f1_vs_time", width = 16, height = 5)
```

## M2.1 — Accuracy vs cost (F1 × wall time)

The manuscript's practical recommendation: which method gives the best
accuracy per unit of compute? Default settings only.

```{r m2-1, results = "asis"}
view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  accuracy_vs_cost <- f1_all_ranks(res) |>
    left_join(
      costs_for(v$dataset, res) |>
        select(phase, wall_time_s, peak_resident_mb, mean_cpu_pct),
      by = c("method_db" = "phase")
    )

  fig_m2_cost_species <- accuracy_vs_cost |>
    filter(tax_level == "Gen_sp", !is.na(wall_time_s)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = wall_time_s / 3600, y = values, color = algo)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(aes(label = db), size = 2.2, max.overlaps = 20,
                              show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Wall time (hours)", y = "F1 score (Gen_sp rank)", color = "Method") +
    theme_bw()
  print(fig_m2_cost_species)
  save_fig(fig_m2_cost_species, paste0("fig_m2_cost_species_", v$id), width = 8, height = 6)

  fig_m2_cost_allranks <- accuracy_vs_cost |>
    filter(!is.na(wall_time_s)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = wall_time_s / 3600, y = values, color = algo, shape = db)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = db_shapes) +
    facet_wrap(~tax_level, nrow = 1) +
    labs(x = "Wall time (hours)", y = "F1 score", color = "Method", shape = "Database") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  print(fig_m2_cost_allranks)
  save_fig(fig_m2_cost_allranks, paste0("fig_m2_cost_allranks_", v$id), width = 18, height = 5)
})
```

## M2.2 — CO₂eq per assignment target

Carbon footprint (gCO2eq) estimated via `greenAlgoR::ga_footprint()` from
`wall_time_s`, WORLD carbon intensity; `n_cores` is the cores the computation
really used, its CPU time (worker and children) over its wall time (blastn
uses about one core whatever its threads; dada2 and lca about 4 of 6 in the
smoke test), and `memory_ram` its
measured peak memory, the R worker **and** vsearch / BLAST+ (`peak_tree_mb`,
`R/sample_tree.R`). Without it `ga_footprint()` charges every computation
the machine's whole RAM (62 GB, two thirds of the footprint of a one-thread
job; code review §1.4). Computations logged before the process-tree sampler
(before M2.4) have no such peak: their CO₂ is left empty.

```{r m2-2, results = "asis"}
# CO2eq of every computation of a cost table with a wall time and a
# process-tree memory peak (ga_footprint() cannot take NA); the others get NA.
add_co2 <- function(costs) {
  # Stores logged before the process-tree sampler lack these columns.
  for (col in c("wall_s", "cpu_self_s", "cpu_child_s", "peak_tree_mb")) {
    if (!col %in% names(costs)) {
      costs[[col]] <- NA_real_
    }
  }
  costs <- costs |>
    mutate(wall_time_s = coalesce(wall_s, wall_time_s)) |>
    filter(!is.na(wall_time_s), !is.na(peak_tree_mb), !is.na(cpu_child_s))
  if (nrow(costs) == 0) {
    # ga_footprint() fails on empty input: no measured computation yet.
    return(mutate(costs, co2eq_gCO2 = numeric()))
  }
  costs |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      co2eq_gCO2 = greenAlgoR::ga_footprint(
        runtime_h      = wall_time_s / 3600,
        # World-mean carbon intensity, stated explicitly so a changed package
        # default cannot silently change the figures (ROADMAP M2.5)
        location_code  = "WORLD",
        n_cores        = max(1, (cpu_self_s + cpu_child_s) / wall_time_s),
        memory_ram     = peak_tree_mb / 1000,
        add_ref_values = FALSE
      )$carbon_footprint_total_gCO2
    ) |>
    ungroup()
}

view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  accuracy_vs_co2 <- f1_all_ranks(res) |>
    left_join(
      costs_for(v$dataset, res) |>
        filter(phase %in% res$method_db) |>
        add_co2() |>
        select(phase, co2eq_gCO2),
      by = c("method_db" = "phase")
    )

  fig_m2_co2_genus <- accuracy_vs_co2 |>
    filter(tax_level == "Genus", !is.na(co2eq_gCO2)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = co2eq_gCO2, y = values, color = algo)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      aes(label = db), size = 2.2, max.overlaps = 20, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      x = expression(CO[2]*"eq (gCO2)"),
      y = "F1 score (Genus)",
      color = "Method"
    ) +
    theme_bw()
  if (nrow(filter(accuracy_vs_co2, !is.na(co2eq_gCO2))) == 0) {
    cat("No computation of this view has a process-tree memory peak yet (logged before M2.4): no CO₂ figure.\n\n")
    return(invisible())
  }
  print(fig_m2_co2_genus)
  save_fig(fig_m2_co2_genus, paste0("fig_m2_co2_genus_", v$id), width = 8, height = 6)

  fig_m2_co2_allranks <- accuracy_vs_co2 |>
    filter(!is.na(co2eq_gCO2)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = co2eq_gCO2, y = values, color = algo, shape = db)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = db_shapes) +
    facet_wrap(~tax_level, nrow = 1) +
    labs(
      x = expression(CO[2]*"eq (gCO2)"),
      y = "F1 score",
      color = "Method",
      shape = "Database"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  print(fig_m2_co2_allranks)
  save_fig(fig_m2_co2_allranks, paste0("fig_m2_co2_allranks_", v$id), width = 18, height = 5)
})
```

## M2.3 — DADA2 preprocessing cost

Cost of the denoising step, attributable separately from the assignments
(`benchmark_costs_dada2` in each dataset's DADA2 store), one tab per dataset.

```{r m2-3, results = "asis"}
cat("\n::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(analysis_datasets))) {
  cat("### ", analysis_datasets$dataset[i], "\n\n", sep = "")
  store <- analysis_datasets$dada2_store[i]
  # benchmark_costs_dada2 only exists once the dada2 project has been rebuilt
  # with the per-phase autometric logging.
  if (targets::tar_exist_objects("benchmark_costs_dada2", store = store)) {
    tar_read(benchmark_costs_dada2, store = store) |>
      arrange(desc(wall_time_s)) |>
      cat_kable(
        digits = 1,
        caption = "DADA2 phases: wall time (s), peak resident memory (MB), mean CPU (%)"
      )
  } else {
    cat("`benchmark_costs_dada2` not built yet in `", basename(store), "`.\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
cat(":::\n\n")
```
